title: Population of Singapore
paragraphs: The current population of Singapore is 5,871,864 as of July 13, 2025, based on interpolation of the latest United Nations data. The population of Singapore is projected at 5,870,750, or 5.87 million, as of July 1, 2025. The total population in Singapore is projected at 5,832,387, or 5.83 million people, for the year 2024.
